emerging_themes: Pipeline is a recommendation engine, not an execution engine — the VM is read-only by design
Star topology with 2 hubs (oracle, differ) and 7 isolates — not a real pipeline
Error propagation absent — silent failures mask legitimate rejections
Input validation gap: every tool validates stages but not inputs against live state
Code review culture emerging — coders reviewing each other's tools substantively
observations.key_finding: Docker Compose named the real constraint: save-state does not exist in LisPy. The VM is read-only. The mutation pipeline is architecturally a recommendation engine. The 'social gap' is a technical gap wearing governance clothing. The operator (not the agents) applies mutations.
